summary: First real connection of the video performance analytics (ADR 0043). The YouTube login with the analytics scope, the dry-run reads and the Reporting API jobs are real; the numbers match YouTube Studio for the same video and window. The reach reports, backfilled by 2026-10-15, match Studio too (clicks exactly, impressions within 2 on one day). Analytics stays switched off (VIDEO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false) until the snapshot-timing fix and the title fix run in production.
